prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1418; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its lower section, and the tail lamp assembly on the driver's side is broken. The trunk lid shows a crease running toward the center, with paint transfer consistent with the reported impact. A few older scratches are visible on the lower quarter panel and may predate this loss. Most of the listed damage fits the described collision. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested run slightly above what this damage typically requires, so a review of the allocated time is recommended before approval.
